Where she ended: She ended at her opening position and agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn in writing, an apology, and a meeting with the principal; that is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time ran out before you got anywhere near it.

What cost ground: You kept repeating that Owen cheated, and at one point suggested she wrote the essay herself, without showing anything, which only told her you had decided first and would never be able to prove it.
